messages:
olivia: 02:18 UTC — apiserver p95 ~800ms in eu-west1, controller-manager requeues x3. Watch backlog rising. https://grafana.redwood.net/d/controlplane/apiserver-dashboard :eyes:

sam: @olivia can you paste the pod / node hot lists?

olivia: datadog shows etcd leader io-read-latency spike at 02:12, raft heartbeat +90ms, a lot of watch reconnects.

deploy-bot: [deploy] controlplane/api v3.4.1 rolled by ci/cd at 02:09 UTC :white_check_mark:

jia: seeing high fd counts on api-server proxies and NAT SNAT conn exhaustion on cloudnat-3 (eu-west1). Lots of ephemeral connections from kubelet attach flows.

mike: also observed GPU nodepool autoscaling ~02:08-02:13, many attach/detach events. Could be thundering GPU onboarding hitting control plane fanout.

oncall: mitigation suggestions: pause nodepool autoscaler, scale kube-apiserver replicas 3->5, and throttle controller-manager reconcile for GPU CRDs.

sam: quick check — any correlated infra deploys or infra config changes?

olivia: no infra deploys besides that controlplane/api roll at 02:09. Kernel pagecache and iostats on etcd nodes look normal-ish but read tail latency spikes.

sam: command to pause autoscaler (manual workaround): `kubectl annotate nodepool gpu-pool redwood/pause-autoscaler=true`

olivia: I scaled apiserver in kube-system: `kubectl -n kube-system scale deployment kube-apiserver --replicas=5` — started 02:25 UTC.

jia: snippet from etcd logs around 02:12:
```
time=\"2026-03-21T02:12:07Z\" level=warn msg=\"read loop delay\" dur=0.121s component=etcdserver
time=\"2026-03-21T02:13:01Z\" level=warn msg=\"raft heartbeat latency\" dur=0.095s component=raft
# many transport retries and short lived conns from 10.40.*/32
```

mike: applying a temporary rate limit on controller-manager for GPU CRDs (reconcile target -> 20 r/s) to stop the thundering reconcilers.

sam: patch example to set env (quick): `kubectl -n kube-system patch deploy controller-manager -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"controller-manager","env":[{"name":"RECONCILE_RATE","value":"20"}]}]}}}}'`

olivia: after autoscaler pause + apiserver scale + controller throttle, p95 dropped to ~200ms and requeues back to baseline within 8m. Monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup:

jia: created ticket SRE-2392 with logs, grafana links and node attach traces: https://issues.redwood.net/browse/SRE-2392

mike: follow-up action: plan infra change to put GPU onboarding into separate nodepool (isolates attach churn) and provision an extra SNAT pool for control-plane egress in eu-west1.

oncall: owners assigned: olivia (investigation + monitoring), jia (etcd/raft deep-dive), mike (nodepool plan), sam (autoscaler safeguards).

olivia: will draft a short incident note if we see recurrence. For now we consider mitigations successful and closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
